R1.reason: Description says 'Measurements / plans can be found under the "Extras" tab', but the cut list carries every part size and the step images (viewed: 2affd2f5 trim/window dimensions, ad10dc30 back panel 73 1/2, 5d2827de side-panel back detail, 9fdf0cdd roof panels, 960bb13a ledger/slat detail) hold the drawings; no step defers a part, size or template to Extras/PDF.

R2.reason: Every part the steps make maps to a cut-list row (side panels [0], trim [1]-[9], 2x4 edge supports [10], V roof support [11], pickets [12], ledgers [13]-[14], slats [15], back panel [16]-[17], supports [18]). The one part with no row, the platform plywood, is cut by steps[6] from listed 3/4 plywood ('cut a piece of 3/4 plywood down to size'); its missing size is recorded in gaps.

R3.reason: Flagged cutList[18] 'Support beams for assembling bed and attaching panels' (3 x 1.5x3.5x73.5) is the part steps[5] uses: 'Connect the two side panels with 3 total 2x4 supports'. Not an assembly or placeholder.

R4.reason: cutList[12] thinner than stock — would need planing/resawing, not judged

R5.reason: Precondition not met (6 stock types, steps do not name stock per part). For the record: the 3/4 x 3.5 perimeter trim rows [1]-[3] total 4x49.25 + 4x24.0625 + 2x39.5 = 372.25 in, vs only 3 x 1x4 x 96 = 288 in of 3.5-wide stock named; ripping from plywood or pickets is not excluded by the plan, so no fail is claimed.

R6.reason: Flagged '4 1/4 inch reveals' (steps[3]) is a gap between pickets, not a nail size (image 9fdf0cdd labels '4 1/4 reveals between slats on roof'). Steps name 'finish nails' and 'pocket hole' joinery with no sizes; materials list 1 1/4" and 1" 15 GA finish nails and 1 1/2" / 2 1/2" pocket screws. steps[3] 'Attach together with nails' gives no size; no two sizes for one use.

R8.reason: Panels, supports and platform parts are cut/built before the assembly in steps[5]-[6]; plugs, paint, filler follow assembly. The roof panels' missing install step is recorded under R14(b).
